profile.summary: Nepris was a Texas education technology company whose platform matches teachers and students with industry professionals for live virtual career conversations. In 2022 it merged with Virtual Job Shadow to form Pathful Inc., and the Nepris platform became Pathful Connect. Pathful offers career readiness and exploration tools for schools.

sources.title: Virtual Job Shadow and Nepris Announce New Company, Pathful Inc.
